Crowd fear (CAG 1.09, Fear z=+1.47) supplies a contrarian bullish edge. Aggregate put-heavy flow (P/C 1.73) is mostly multileg hedging, not directional, while deep ITM calls in TSLA/NVDA lean bullish. Because regime confidence is only 21%, spot sits at the 7200 call wall, and Asia tech is weak, confidence stays low (intraday 36, next-day 46, 30-day 62). Ranges are widened to the VIX-implied 1.66% daily and 7.6% monthly moves.
